title: Session resources
sqlTemplate: select _timestamp, session_id, view_id, type, resource_type, resource_method, resource_status_code, resource_duration, resource_size, resource_url, service, env, version from _rumdata where session_id = {{session_id}} and type = 'resource' order by _timestamp asc limit 100
emptyDataSemantics: No matching records -> an empty result set (zero rows), not an error.
